OTempFileService retains all represented UNO IO/seek/endpoint/property/type/ByteReader contracts, original first-use caches/defaults/exception order, UInt32 seek cast, duplicate XPropertySet types, release-profile assert-only listener bodies and ignored creation/close diagnostics. Original OSL directory enumeration is now bound to genuine selected libc opendir/readdir/closedir with compiler-selected dirent field accessors, not a JS cursor or host filesystem. DirectoryImpl remains in original file_misc owner. URL conversion, trailing separator removal and the already approved read gate precede native open; original C argument validation/output preservation, dot filtering, byte-path concatenation, d_type, item release/replacement, null-readdir NOENT and close-before-record destruction are retained. Original Directory header constructor/URL/open/isOpen/close/reset/getNextItem wrappers replace the previous static-only facet while retaining existing static creation APIs. Original UNIX constructor/open/isOpen/close/reset/getNextItem assertions and actual Unicode/link/slot/lifetime tests pass; Chromium main/DOM-free Worker enumerate and reset an actual registered TempFile parent directory. Native OOM, invalid DIR pointers, readdir/closedir injected errors and repeated-open leak behavior remain unqualified. WRITER603..604/CALC666..667 document source concerns.
